text: At 35 minutes, Kingsmoor FC took control with a momentum index of 0.489 over the previous 8 minutes, supported by five final third entries and an xG of 1.29, demonstrating effective territorial and attacking dominance. Operating from a 4-4-2 with a wide, crossing play style, Kingsmoor exploited flank overloads to generate sustained pressure and create multiple shooting opportunities, including the big chance by Felix Duarte at 38 minutes (xG 0.989). Their moderate pressing intensity (PPDA 9.7) disrupted Westport Albion’s direct vertical passing game, contributing to Westport’s higher turnover count and reduced field tilt, allowing Kingsmoor to maintain possession (51.7%) and territorial control during this phase. This mechanism of flank overload combined with controlled rest-defense and effective pressing allowed Kingsmoor to dictate play despite several blocked and off-target shots.
